caption: The drawing depicts a painted sculpture of a female figure standing on a rectangular wooden base. The figure has light skin and long dark brown hair styled in a braid, with a crown or headdress featuring spherical decorations on top. She is wearing a high-neck dress with a red bodice, green sleeves, and a wide, flared skirt that is predominantly black with brown-orange horizontal bands and dark flower-like patterns. The outer edges of the skirt and bodice are outlined in green, and the lower part of the skirt is decorated with a scalloped brown-orange band. The figure's right arm is bent upward at the elbow with an open hand, while the left arm is bent outward with the hand showing three raised fingers. The sculpture has a stylized appearance and is set against a plain, off-white background. The artist's signature and location, "Matesl G. Caplin - Taos N.M.," is written in the lower right corner.
title: Large Painted Wooden Saint-Virgin Mary
